_meta.purpose: Maps each raw dataset's folder/label names to PSD-HP's four canonical target classes.

special_values.EXCLUDE_NOT_TARGET: Folder exists but is not one of the four target diseases; scanner/extractor must skip it.
special_values.AMBIGUOUS_MERGED: Folder mixes more than one target disease and needs a disambiguation strategy before extraction (see notes).

_meta.note_dermnet_canonical_keys: The four canonical-class keys under 'DermNet' below (Psoriasis, Lichen_Planus, Pityriasis_Rosea, Seborrheic_Dermatitis) are identity mappings consumed by images the DermNetAdapter's per-image filename classifier already resolved to a canonical class directly (e.g. 'psoriasis-scalp-90.jpg'). They are NOT raw on-disk folder names — mapper.py's logic is unchanged; the adapter simply now sometimes hands it a normalized_label that already equals a target class.
_meta.version: 0.3 (adapter-layer + per-image DermNet filename classification + Atlas ISIC31 integration)
